targets.recipient_name: Linda Schucroft and Oman Airports Strategy Team
targets.subject: Executive Value Proposal | Aviation Strategy, Government & ESG | Oman Airports
targets.email_verification_source: Oman Civil Aviation Authority's current aerodrome information publishes oamcinfo@omanairports.com as the Oman Airports contact email. Oman Airports leadership materials identify Linda Schucroft as Chief Strategy, Digital & Experience Officer.
facts: Oman Airports manages airport infrastructure and passenger experience across the Sultanate, linking aviation growth with tourism, digital transformation and national development.
The remit spans strategy, customer experience, public-sector coordination and long-term infrastructure performance.

themes.title: Aviation & Institutional Strategy
themes.context: Airport growth requires coordinated alignment across government, aviation regulators, airlines, operators, communities, investors and national development priorities over time.
themes.contribution: I bring director-level government and regulatory coordination, executive briefing and stakeholder governance from a complex multinational operating environment with public-sector interfaces.

themes.title: ESG & Infrastructure Delivery
themes.context: Airport assets face increasing expectations around energy efficiency, climate resilience, social value, transparent sustainability performance and accountable infrastructure governance.
themes.contribution: My ESG, renewable-energy and assurance experience supports measurable sustainability governance tied directly to operating delivery, evidence ownership and executive oversight.

themes.title: Country Growth & Partnerships
themes.context: Aviation-led economic development depends on trusted partnerships across tourism, investment, logistics, infrastructure, airlines, communities and public institutions at country level.
themes.contribution: I support partnership development, institutional mapping, government engagement and executive coordination across high-value country growth priorities and complex stakeholder environments.
